title: team-review.js skips when a team member is already requested, using live API reviewers
answers: team-review assigned a third reviewer on re-run
double counted review stats after re-running workflow
how does team-review avoid duplicate reviewer assignment
why are reviewers read from the API instead of the event payload
body:
Symptom: re-running the team-review workflow (or a queued duplicate run) assigns an extra reviewer and double-counts the stats issue.
Root cause: .github/workflows/team-review.js:module.exports read `context.payload.pull_request.requested_reviewers`, a snapshot from the event that does not reflect reviewers assigned by earlier runs.
Fix pattern: read requests via `github.rest.pulls.listRequestedReviewers` and return early when a requested user is a `stats.reviewCounts` key, excluding `copilotInitiator`. The early return must run before eligible reviewers are chosen.
Constraints: Copilot and non-team requests must not suppress team review; .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml requests @copilot on eligible PRs, so a Copilot-only request must still lead to 2 team reviewers. Manually requested non-team users must not block assignment either.
applies: Any change to reviewer selection or stats handling in .github/workflows/team-review.js.
says: Re-running review assignment adds an unexpected third reviewer to the pull request.
Review statistics tracking issue double-counts reviewer metrics whenever the assignment workflow reruns.
Stop the reviewer assignment bot from adding duplicate team reviewers during workflow retries.
Why does re-triggering team review request an extra reviewer instead of keeping current ones?
Prevent automated reviewer assignment from assigning additional reviewers to already assigned pull requests.
search: Reviewer selection in .github/workflows/team-review.js must check live reviewers via github.rest.pulls.listRequestedReviewers and exit early before choosing eligible reviewers if a team member is already requested. Reading context.payload.pull_request.requested_reviewers used a stale event snapshot, causing workflow re-runs or queued runs to assign a third reviewer and double-count reviewer tallies in stats.reviewCounts. The early return checks if a requested user is a stats.reviewCounts key while excluding copilotInitiator. Copilot requests from .github/workflows/copilot-review.yml and manually requested non-team users must not suppress team review or block the assignment of two team reviewers.
